Please excuse my continued request.
Could you please draw a group of three creative characters?

They are a twin brother who is a quick-tempered twin, a twin sister who is a pain in the ass, and two childhood friends who are troublemakers.
All three are children of the Mafia, and by day they are ordinary middle school students, and by night they fight as members of the family.
Please refer to the attached documents for their appearance, personalities, and relationships.

We will leave the composition and clothing to you.
It does not have to be an even size of the three, and it is also fine if someone is out of the picture or in the reflection. We are also happy if you can arrange the clothing.
Please draw them as you like!

We would appreciate it if you would consider our proposal.
Thank you very much!

Eyes: Gold Hair: Brown

I am very pleased to meet you. I like your drawing style so much that I have sent this request to you.

Angel rings (any shape you like!)

A black open-fronted hoodie with a large hood and light blue lines.
Short bangs at the eyebrow line, bob to medium length hair.
Black umbrella color with white hair (more white)

Other settings and detailed images are available in the document, but as long as the above elements are included, you may add, subtract, or alter other elements as you wish.

初めまして！絵が素敵で魅力的なので、リクエストさせていただきたいと思います！

主人公で探偵さん。あんまり素直じゃない子。言ってることはほとんど嘘で、周りの人の期待に答えるように演じている。
昔はピアノの天才だと思われ、ケガのためやまてしまった。
犯人を探しながら、自分の過去の向き合ってしまう。この役割で償いを求め、自分の結末に償いの意味を与えたい。

イラストの方は特にアイディアがないので、ご自由に描いていただければうれしいです。咲苗によく付き合うものは：傘、雨、白い菊、チェス（特に黒駒）。冷たいや暗い雰囲気、メランコリック的な絵が似合うと思います。ご自由に描いていただきたいので、お任せします！
キャラクターなどは好みではなければ、いつでもキャンセルでかまいません！
よろしくお願いいたします！

Dr. 410.
I enjoy your illustrations very much.
May I ask you to illustrate our children?

*The personalities and contents of our children
Female:
Height: 152.4 cm
A timeless witch who is tired of living.
She is an immortal witch, talented but quite lazy.
She is very cunning and clever, but acts childishly to hide her true personality.
She is the type who likes to tease her lover, but she is easily embarrassed when teased.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1u_of6zgnnFLBE88zFJS8HC1X5tTALzOW?usp=sharing

Male:
Height: 182.9 cm
He is a cynical, quiet and serious devil. He likes to play with people's feelings.
He likes to deceive others by pretending to be noble and charming.
But in truth, he is very abusive and cruel and does not hesitate to harm others.
He is sweet to his girlfriend and a bit of a yandere!
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IpFwQWWrPBm6nrpgyXVG2mX0H_gQDHuf?usp=sharing

*Other references
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yIF2OPyr-Fb_8ogff_-BSf27UxuNsVPn?usp=sharing

*The relationship between the two
They are two enemies of the world.
The woman is a witch of chaos who is tired of humanity.
The man is a ruthless demon who sees humanity as entertainment.
They met by chance, and at first they were enemies.
But as time goes by, they come to respect each other's power.
Now, they enjoy disrupting the world for their amusement.
When they are not terrorizing mankind, they like to go to cafes and take walks on the beach.
Basically, they enjoy life like any normal couple.

*Composition
We leave everything to you, including costumes and composition.
I would appreciate it if you could draw freely!
Thank you for considering my request.
